newsitem.title: ITALY: Cariplo Q1 1997 deposits, profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Cariplo Q1 1997 deposits, profit rise.

text.p: Italian savings bank Cassa di Risparmio delle Provincie Lombarde (Cariplo) said first quarter 1997 gross profit was above target at 491 billion lire.
It said in a statement after the annual shareholders' meeting that deposits rose 8.1 percent to 113.37 trillion lire while total loans were 6.5 percent up at 124.42 trillion lire.
The statement said the trend of the first three months led the bank to already forecast "a significant improvement in results for the whole year."
Cariplo posted 1996 consolidated net profit of 123 billion lire against 326 billion lire in 1995.
